summary: 5&5 is a restaurant IT and digital platform management company supporting more than 20,000 locations and 140+ restaurant brands, including CKE, Tropical Smoothie Cafe, Bojangles and Raising Cane's. (Scope note: Customer count and brand list are from the vendor's own site, not independently verified by trade press.)
5&5 was named a 2026 Inc. 5000 honoree, reporting 101% three-year revenue growth.
5&5 provides Level 1/2 support and managed services for POS, SaaS and loyalty platforms including Restaurant365, Decision Logic, and Crunchtime.
